mismatches.say: Under the twenty thirteen claims-made C G L, the basic tail is free and automatic. It gives sixty days for occurrences never reported, and five years for those reported no later than sixty days after the end.
mismatches.heard: Under the 2013 claims made CGL, the basic tale is free and automatic. It gives 60 days for occurrences never reported, and five years for those reported no later than 60 days after the end.

mismatches.say: The supplemental tail is optional. Request it in writing within sixty days. It costs up to two hundred percent of the annual premium, never ends, and reinstates the aggregates.

mismatches.say: Neither tail covers injury after the policy ends.
